generalCriterionList.description: A valid copy of KPWD/PWD/KNNL registration certificate (As above mentioned).
The requisite Earnest Money Deposit in e-cash
Valid EPF registration certificate and latest paid challan.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Latest Copy of Income Tax Return filed for the Financial Year 2025-26 (Assessment Year 2026-27) mentioning the PAN. Or latest.
IT Permanent Account Number (PAN) Card of the bidder, issued by Income Tax Department.

The Intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least one any Construction work of value not less than 25% of the amount put to tender during last five years reckoned back from 2025-26.(i.e. work executed during, 2021-22 2022-23 2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26 will be considered). The work done certificate should be issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer of the concerned division/ equivalent officer/ next higher officer. (For Sl No,7,8,9 & 10 Works)

The bidder should have achieved in at least one financial years a minimum financial turn-over of not less than amount put to tender in last five years. Audited balance sheet is to be uploaded along with the technical bid. Audited balance sheet for One financial years in which not less than amount put to tender, turn-over achieved, out of 2021-22 2022-23 2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-26. is to be uploaded with the technical bid. The cost will be updated to the present value by the giving weight age of 10% each year. If the work is completed prior to the year 2025-26.(For Sl No,7,8,9 & 10 Works)

Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant Document certifying his/her status as Schedule castes or Schedule Tribe CAT I and CAT IIA other reserved category as prescribed above table(For Sl No,7,8,9 & 10 Works)
The contractor belonging to Schedule castes or Schedule Tribe, CAT I and CAT IIA shall be Domicile of state Of Karnataka for more than 10 years as prescribed above table (For Sl No,7,8,9 & 10 Works)

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Removal of Silt from Km. 0.00 to 30.00 of RBC of Amarja Project

itemList.description: Cutting and removing jauliflora bushes upto 1.50 m girth excluding removal of stumps and including burning or disposing off the materials with all lead and lift, etc. complete and as per the direction of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

Cutting and burning or disposing off Apu/ Jondu from marshy areas as directed with all other ancillary operations with all lead and lift, etc. complete and as per the direction of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

De-silting in tank bed/ Feeder Channel/ Canal in dry condition by excavating the deposited bed material and disposing off the same by stacking/ formation of Embankment or as directed including cost of all machinery, labour & all necessary works with all lead and lift, etc. complete and as per the direction of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

Excavation and removal of silt and silt mixed with sand from canal bed by manual means including disposing off the same in spoil bank or on the canal embankment in layers as directed with all other ancillary operations with all lead and lift, etc. complete and as per the direction of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means in all kinds of soils upto 3 m  depth for all works & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenaces required with all lead and lift, etc. complete and as per the direction of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.
